info.title: bee
info.description: bee — config-driven AI dev CLI. All secrets live in MongoDB, never in the binary.

commands.name: ask
commands.description:
Ask the configured model (DeepSeek/OpenAI/Anthropic). Reads stdin if no prompt —
an AI-to-AI access point

options.name: --system
options.description:
Optional system prompt (added on top of the active
soul)

options.name: --soul
options.description:
Use a specific persona for this call instead of the
active one

options.name: --no-soul
options.description: Ignore the active persona for this call

options.name: --tools
options.description:
Let the model call bee's tools (memory/skill/config).
Read tools only, unless --allow-write
Default: denied by the gate

options.name: --allow-write
options.description:
Permit write/sensitive tools (memory_save, config_get).
Default: denied by the gate

options.name: --raw
options.description:
Print only the answer (no header). Default when stdout
is piped

arguments.name: PROMPT
arguments.description: The question. If omitted, bee reads the prompt from stdin

commands.name: config
commands.description: Manage shared config stored in Mongo (keys, secrets, endpoints)

commands.name: get
commands.description: Get a value from the shared config store

commands.name: path
commands.description: Print the local bootstrap config path

commands.name: set
commands.description: Set a value in the shared config store

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show local bootstrap + remote config (secrets masked)

commands.name: hook
commands.description:
Steer the AI: emit identity + rules + memory for agent hooks; manage behavioral
rules

commands.name: install
commands.description: Print the Claude Code settings.json hook snippet (--scope user|project|local)

options.name: --scope
options.description:
user | project | local — which settings.json the snippet
targets (default: user)

commands.name: prompt
commands.description: Emit per-prompt steering (rules + relevant memory). Reads stdin

commands.name: rule
commands.description: Behavioral rules injected by the hooks

commands.name: session-start
commands.description: Emit session-start steering (identity + rules + recent memory)

commands.name: howto
commands.description:
Pattern/how-to store (Mongo-backed). Bare text searches; get/add/list/rm manage
your conventions

options.name: --body
options.description: The how-to content (markdown). Prompted if omitted

arguments.name: VERB
arguments.description: get | add | list | rm | search — or the search query

commands.name: init
commands.description: Configure bee: store the single Mongo connection everything else is pulled from

options.name: --mongo
options.description:
Mongo connection string. Supplying this runs
init headless (bootstrap only, no prompts)

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing config without prompting

commands.name: remember
commands.description:
Persistent memory (decisions/errors/learnings). Bare text saves;
'context/search/stats/history' query

options.name: --semantic
options.description:
Rank by embedding (cosine) similarity instead of token
match

arguments.name: ACTION
arguments.description: A verb (context/search/stats/history) or the content to save

arguments.name: CONTENT
arguments.description: Content when the first arg is a verb like 'search'

commands.name: skill
commands.description:
Query a skill-bridge (domain skills) over MCP. Config-driven:
search/list/get/resolve/categories/suggest/tools

arguments.name: ACTION
arguments.description:
search | list | get | resolve | categories | stats | suggest |
tools

arguments.name: ARGS
arguments.description: query / path / category / file paths (per action)

commands.name: soul
commands.description:
SOUL protocol — bee's persona/identity. Bare shows the active soul;
list/use/add/show/claim/remove

arguments.name: VERB
arguments.description:
list | use | add | show | claim | remove | clear (default: show
active)
